Return for RO-1007:

Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, unused and with original tags/packaging.
To start the return, provide your order number and the email used for the order. A return case will be opened, and you’ll get a prepaid return label by email within one business day.
If the item was damaged or incorrect, return shipping is free; otherwise, a $6.95 fee is deducted from your refund.
Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after the item arrives at the warehouse.

How to pitch the Summit 2 Tent:

The Summit 2 is a three-season, freestanding tent for two people.
It weighs just 4 lb 2 oz (with stakes and rainfly).
Features include two doors and two vestibules for easy access and gear storage.
Setup is quick—about 10 minutes with color-coded poles and simple clips.
It’s not designed for snow or winter camping, but is perfect for spring, summer, and fall adventures.
